readings.lamp*/hl-*: lens centres at 4x (pk006): lamp*-head = marker, hl-* = headlamp, lamp*-tail = red tail
readings.sc-*/gw-*: yellow-to-rubber edges as lines fitted along scanlines (rms 0.1-0.6 px), virtual corners; the near screen's inner edge is crossed by the wiper and its reflections (fits disagree by 14 px): not used
readings.w*-bottom: saloon window glass bottom and front/rear edges inside the silver frame, fitted lines; their tops are lost in reflections and the black window band
readings.d*c-top: door aperture (doors open) top midpoint between its fitted edges
